title: Choose the visual world for LendLoop
question: The roll assigned The Key Cabinet. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Key Cabinet
options.lineage: a building super's key cabinet: enamelled steel, numbered hook rows, coloured card tags, embossed label tape
options.thesis: Every tool is a tag on a numbered hook; an empty hook means it is out on loan.
options.viewport: The cabinet opens edge to edge: the tagline punched as embossed tape strips on the inside door, the live tool list hanging as colour-coded tags on a numbered hook rail, the sign-in action as a key fob.
options.risk: Tag colour coding can get noisy if more than one colour per category creeps in.

raised.raise: State is physical, not a badge: requested tags get punched, out-on-loan leaves an empty hook.
Every loan carries one unbroken date rail with a marker on today.
Selection is decisive: the active filter tape inverts completely.
Type carries the opening: the tagline is the hero, no illustration.
Each tag keeps its story: the back of the tag lists its notifications and reminders.
One long horizontal hook rail organises every page.

options.label: The Shadow Board
options.lineage: tool-library pegboards with each tool's outline painted where it hangs
options.thesis: A painted silhouette shows where each tool lives, and when it is missing.
options.viewport: A pegboard wall fills the screen, tools drawn as silhouettes in their painted outlines, the tagline stencilled above.
options.risk: The familiar workshop look; needs a silhouette drawn for every tool type, and hardboard brown can read dated.

options.label: HyperCard Shoebox
options.thesis: The board as a stack of one-bit cards you browse and edit in place.
options.viewport: A fixed card with painted buttons linking to each view.
options.risk: Reads as retro tech, not as a neighbourhood.
options.case: Fuses poorly: neighbours don't identify with a 1987 Mac stack, and dithered states cost clarity.
options.kept: States expressed physically, without extra colour.

options.label: Rhythm Machine Step Row
options.thesis: Loan dates punched into a 16-step row under a chase light.
options.viewport: A step row as the date picker, tempo readout as today.
options.risk: A music instrument metaphor confuses a lending task.
options.case: Fuses poorly: nobody expects to borrow a ladder on a sequencer.
options.kept: One unbroken timeline with now always marked.

options.label: Rebel Menu Collage
options.thesis: Every view a torn-paper splash at reckless angles.
options.viewport: Scarlet field with sheared italic options.
options.risk: Too aggressive and too playful for a job assignment.
options.case: Fuses poorly: fails both 'not childish' and 'easy to use'.
options.kept: Decisive selection: the chosen option flips completely.

options.label: Highlife Record Sleeve
options.thesis: Tools presented like bandleaders on painted sleeves.
options.viewport: Arched hand-brushed LendLoop over a colour field.
options.risk: Needs portrait imagery the product does not have.
options.case: Fuses poorly: no portraits exist, and the music frame hides the offer.
options.kept: Type as the hero of the opening.

options.label: Moon-Shadow Bazaar
options.thesis: Tools traded like shadows down a moonlit lane.
options.viewport: A dark lane of stalls, each tool a tagged shadow.
options.risk: Dreamlike mood undercuts trust and scanability.
options.case: Fuses poorly: surreal framing loses neighbours and reviewers alike.
options.kept: Every item keeps its ticket of origin and story attached.

options.label: Indoor Weather Sun
options.lineage: an amber installation hall with a mirrored ceiling
options.thesis: One vast amber hall walked toward a half sun.
options.viewport: An amber horizon band with silhouettes as items.
options.risk: Atmosphere without a task; amber duotone kills category colour.
options.case: Fuses poorly: beautiful, but nothing in it is about lending.
options.kept: One long horizontal axis that organises the page.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A peer-to-peer marketplace grid, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Headline and search on top, a grid of listing cards below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other submission by design.
